newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slip in early morning on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped in early morning trade on Monday, the first trading day of the year, as the market was dragged down by the weaker yen.
Dealers expected the key stock index to drift close to the 19,000 point level today.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 average lost 77.46 points or 0.40 percent to 19,283.89 in the first five minutes of trading. Its March futures stood 60 points lower at 19,240.
